name: Counterattack!
summary: At Regthar Deathgate’s outpost west of the Crossroads, Kolkar warriors strike back after their leaders fall. They have crossed from Desolace, and Warlord Krom'zar leads their charge.

sections.title: Vengeance from Desolace
sections.body: The Kolkar have suffered a deep humiliation in the Barrens. Barak Kodobane, Verog the Dervish, and Hezrul Bloodmark are dead, leaving the remaining centaur shattered and without direction. Word of their defeat travels west across the mountains to their ancestral homeland in Desolace. There, a fresh force of hardened Kolkar warriors rallies instead of scattering into the scrubland. Burning for blood and retribution, they cross into the Barrens and march against the young Horde encampments.

sections.title: Defense of the Bunkers
sections.body: Kolkar warriors assault the fortified Horde bunkers west of the Crossroads, where Regthar Deathgate commands the defense. Waves of invaders clash with the Horde grunts stationed there. Warlord Krom'zar leads the warband, his banner rallying the centaur as they charge. The defenders must hold the line, fell Krom'zar, and tear down his war banner to break the centaur threat across the central plains.

faq.q: Why are the Kolkar attacking this specific outpost?
faq.answer: Regthar Deathgate arranged the killings of Kolkar leaders around the Barrens’ oases. Humiliated by their fallen chieftains, the centaur march on his fortified bunkers west of the Crossroads to strike the Horde command post responsible.

faq.q: Where did these centaur reinforcements come from?
faq.answer: The reinforcements cross the western mountain passes from Desolace, the rugged homeland where most centaur clans dwell.
Warlord Krom'zar leads the Kolkar warband from Desolace. He charges Regthar’s bunkers beneath his war banner, which Horde defenders tear down after killing him.

faq.q: Does Thrall learn about this battle?
faq.answer: Yes. Regthar Deathgate promises to send formal word of the battle directly to Warchief Thrall in Orgrimmar. He honors the defense of the Barrens.

faq.q: What happens to the Kolkar presence after this battle?
faq.answer: Krom'zar’s defeat breaks the Kolkar’s last organized force in the central Barrens. Trade routes around the Crossroads are secured, while the remaining tribes are left fragmented and leaderless.

faq.q: What is the piece of Krom'zar's banner used for?
faq.answer: A torn piece of Krom'zar’s banner is physical proof that the warlord is dead. It also marks the collapse of the centaur invasion.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you help defend the bunkers and secure Horde territory in the central Barrens. The defense protects supply lines between Durotar, Mulgore, and the Crossroads.
As a tauren, you help drive back the centaur threat that has hounded your people for generations. Krom'zar’s defeat brings greater security to the plains.
As a warrior, you stand with the outpost grunts against repeated centaur charges. The defense demands endurance on the front line and discipline in battle.
